explain.say: Writing can be done in more than one way. A pencil is one tool. Typing and voice typing are real writing tools too. Many people use them every day. Look at the 2 tools on the board.

explain.say: Now look at voice typing. You talk, and the device writes your words. It helps you get big ideas down quickly. What sentence would you like to say?

faq.a: Yes. Writing means putting your ideas into words. Typing and voice typing are different tools for doing it.

faq.q: How do I use voice typing?
faq.a: Tap the microphone button on the keyboard, then speak clearly. Say full stop or period at the end of each sentence, then read it back.

faq.q: What if voice typing gets a word wrong?
faq.a: That happens to everyone. Tap the wrong word and fix it, or say it again more clearly.
asks: Voice typing wrote the wrong word

faq.a: A little practice is good, for things like your name and short notes. For long writing, it is fine to use the tool that helps you most.

faq.q: How can I get faster at typing?
faq.a: Practise for a few minutes a day with a typing game, keeping your fingers on the middle row of keys. A teacher or grown-up can help you find one.

facts: Voice typing, also called speech to text, is built into most phones, tablets and computers.
In many voice typing tools, saying full stop or period adds a dot at the end of a sentence.

quiz.say: Amira says a sentence into the tablet. What should she do next?
quiz.show: 🎤 Amira voice types a sentence. What next?
quiz.why: The device can hear a word wrong. Reading it back helps you find and fix it.

wrong.0: Your sentence is useful, so keep it and check it.
wrong.1: Turning the tablet off stops you checking your words.

quiz.say: Think about typing on a keyboard. What is one good thing about it?

options.show: It spells every word for you
options.say: It spells every word for you

quiz.why: You can delete a mistake and type the word again.

wrong.0: Spell check can help, but you still choose the letters.
wrong.2: Talking is usually quicker than typing.
